title: New details emerge from chilling dispatch calls before Josh Jacobs’ arrest: ‘Things being thrown’

sources.title: New details emerge from chilling dispatch calls before Josh Jacobs’ arrest: ‘Things being thrown’
sources.description: Newly released dispatch audio revealed that police received two calls concerning Packers running back Josh Jacobs’ alleged domestic violence attack, with one of them being from inside of the home.
